stories.headline: ByteDance Lands $29.6 Billion Loan to Fuel AI Advances
stories.body: China’s ByteDance has reportedly secured a $29.6 billion loan from nearly 30 banks. That’s according to a report Friday (Sept. 4) from Reuters, which says the TikTok owner’s plans for artificial intelligence have attracted strong interest from lenders. The loan is the second-biggest in Asia this year, following the $40 billion SoftBank raised in March

stories.headline: Georgia investors evolve their plan for starting a new bank
stories.body: The group behind the proposed Georgia Skyline Bank says recapitalizing a 24-year-old Virginia bank offers a faster path to success than a new charter would.
